name: shadcn/ui、コピーではなく自分のrepoに残るcomponent libraryへ変えたOSS
summary: Cited Japanese analysis of shadcn/ui: open-code component distribution, CLI and registry, pricing, timeline and competitors.
description: Product-analysis article (published 2026-09-14, 19 cited sources) on shadcn/ui, the open-code component library that ships TypeScript source into the user's repo instead of an npm package. It covers the 2023 side-project story, CLI and registry distribution, an AI-ready angle, pricing and revenue, a growth timeline, SWOT, positioning against Material UI, Chakra UI, Radix UI and Tailwind UI, and lessons for design-system teams.
contains: story: started January 2023 as a personal side project by a Vercel engineer
sections: pricing/revenue, growth timeline, positioning, SWOT, related products
pricing read: open core — core components and CLI open source, free tier
competitors compared: Material UI, Chakra UI, Radix UI, Tailwind UI
stack noted: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, Astro, Tailwind CSS, Vercel hosting
